plan_review.notes: Revised predecessor selection from capturedAt ordering to git first-parent ancestry so out-of-order concurrent sweep completion cannot compare against a future release. Moved issue mutation into a checked-in helper, deduplicating across open and closed issues by hidden SHA marker, reopening/updating existing issues, then reusing runIssueIntake so kickoff instructions precede GraphQL Copilot assignment. Added tests for out-of-order publication, same-SHA reuse, closed reopen, existing unassigned issue, and API failures. Equal totalRuns remains fail-closed with an explicit remediation message.

code_review.notes: Round 1 inspected the wrong standalone workflow for three findings; the actual deploy.yml wiring, detector, and structural test made them inapplicable. Fixed the valid GraphQL injection and invalid-decision coverage findings. Round 2 found the boundary fixture mismatch and non-atomic result write; both were fixed, then targeted and fast verification passed.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation is robust and precise. It safely calculates regression thresholds using integer math to avoid floating-point issues and carefully walks the first-parent lineage to prevent out-of-order publication errors. The issue-filing script elegantly handles deduplication by using hidden HTML markers, reliably updates/reopens existing issues, and handles workflow assignments. Test coverage is extremely thorough, explicitly exercising boundary tolerances, data structure edge cases, and CI workflow boundaries. The scope is well-disciplined with no unrelated changes.
